title: Preview (snapshot estimate) diverges from charged amount (actual skim) with no payment ceiling; getTotalYield ignores per-token pause — no profitable sandwich
rootCauseClass: preview-vs-actual divergence / one-directional slippage guard / view inconsistency
description: Previews (calculateClaimAmount L651, getYield, getTotalYield L738) price off the snapshot estimate _getYieldForStrategy = sum(totalBalanceOf - principalOf) over getAuthorizedClients(), while claim() prices off skimSurplus's post-redeem/post-swap underlyingReceived (L484). This two-source design is FAITHFUL/documented (story-025; _getYieldForStrategy NatSpec L542-547). Two SYA-side issues fold here: (a) minRewardTokenSupplied (L501) is a FLOOR only with no MAX-payment ceiling, so preview-vs-actual divergence can revert a claimer's own approval; (b) getTotalYield (L738) does NOT skip tokenConfigs[token].paused whereas claim()/calculateClaimAmount() do, so the global view over-reports vs the claimable set.
impact: No protocol value loss and no third-party griefing. A claimer's payment always tracks the yield they actually receive (payment = (1-discount)*value-of-delivered-yield under correct config), so an attacker who inflates the victim's actualPayment by donating surplus also gifts the victim discount*donation — econ-scanner concluded NO profitable sandwich exists. Impact is claimer-side UX/self-DoS (revert on safeTransferFrom when actual>preview, NFT preserved, wasted gas) plus unreliable bot quoting because getTotalYield omits the per-token paused skip.
attackPath: 1. Preview (calculateClaimAmount/getYield/getTotalYield) prices off the snapshot estimate sum(totalBalanceOf - principalOf); claim() prices off skimSurplus's post-redeem/post-swap underlyingReceived (L484) — documented to diverge (story-025-faithful, two-source design).
2. minRewardTokenSupplied (L501) is a FLOOR only, with no MAX-payment ceiling.
3a. A claimer who pre-approves exactly the quote can have claim() revert on safeTransferFrom when actual > preview (self-DoS, wasted gas, NFT preserved).
3b. Bots relying on getTotalYield mis-size approvals/min because it counts paused tokens (view inconsistency).
recommendation: Add an optional maxRewardTokenSupplied ceiling to claim() (symmetric to the floor) so claimers can bound overpay; make getTotalYield skip paused tokens for consistency with claim()/calculateClaimAmount(); document that calculateClaimAmount is an estimate and that integrators should buffer approvals.
verification: Static + economic reasoning. No exploit PoC (none warranted — no profitable adversarial path). econ-scanner explicitly down-weighted the pattern-matcher's potential-high/medium MEV framings; code-scanner independently flagged the getTotalYield paused inconsistency as a QA view-layer observation. The strategy-side magnitude of the divergence roots in the OOS strategy adapter (KI#7) and is scoped out; only the SYA-side slice is classified.
